Messages.Author: apathy
Messages.Body:
Two questions:

1. Can a vampire hunt even if it is at full capacity? (The rulebook mentions
that hunting cannot take a vampire -over- its capacity, which seems to imply
that this is a legal action.)

2. If the answer to #1 is "yes," then is this hunting action (when undertaken by
a vamp at full capacity) considered a -successful- action? (IOW, can the vamp
play a Freak Drive after such a hunt, since FD is conditional on the success of
the action?)

As always, thanks in advance. :-)

the previous ruling, which said that a vamp wasn't allowed to hunt if

of

I the action is not blocked, it is successful, as always.

Correct.

-- digression follows, feel free to skip --
The "previous ruling" wasn't actually a "ruling" per se. It was just a
result of the V:TES rulebook text: "Also, a vampire with a number of blood
counters equal to his maximum capacity cannot hunt." [6.4]
Which is an odd construction, anyhow: What "maximum capacity" refers to is
probably "current capacity". (There is no "maximum capacity" - a vampire's
capacity can reach arbitrary levels.)

Anyhow - the Jyhad rulebook did not prohibit at-capacity-hunting, the V:TES rulebook
did, and the current rulebook doesn't. No "ruling" was ever made - just a series
of "clarifications" of the then-current rules.
-- end digression --

Correct.
